purpose: MC-117: OMPS, omp 18.0.0 as OMPF with --system-prompt set to dsh's system prompt for the model, for Qwen3.5-9B (MC-115's route) and MiMo-V2.6-Flash (MC-116's route), draws 1-2 on MC-115's 646 items: does omp's default system prompt carry the model x harness interaction (omp below dsh with Qwen, above with MiMo)?

M.note: 134 Legal MC items on corpus_v1 and 112 VMLU law items on corpus_v2

mc115.use: every OMPS task must equal MC-115's OMPF task of the same item

qwen.route: IEC Qwen3.5-9B-65K through the openvpn3 member-shared-tcp tunnel; endpoint and key from .env OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY; the in-tunnel resolver shim (--tunnel-dns 172.16.30.1); MC-115's omp proxy settings

mimo.route: OpenCode Go mimo-v2.6-flash, MC-116's headers and one x-opencode-session per try; MC-116's omp proxy settings and provider-error rules

scoring.multiple_choice: the frozen MC extractor and scorer (score_vi_multimodel) on the agent's final text or B's response
scoring.reading: vi-reading-v3 (vi_reading_v3.rescore_row): token-F1 primary, EM and gold-token recall descriptive; vi-reading-v2 values kept beside

operational.stall: a proxied stream that ends with no chunk naming a model is recorded as network (stream_stalled), not model_drift; an attempt that ends without an answer after one is technical and re-run by --resume
operational.blocked_rows: a row written without a request carries its run key, shard, lane, model id, protocol id, profile id and card id
operational.launch: one systemd-run --user unit per model; Qwen's with the VPN open for its whole run

budget_basis.qwen: Design §5: the real OMPF tokens per attempt, scaled by the smoke ratio, times 1.5. MC-115's OMPF used 93,028,797 tokens in 1,292 attempts (72,004 each). On the same two smoke questions OMPS used 21,916 tokens (8,230 + 13,686) against OMPF's 28,556 in MC-115's smoke report 46d24a6b (8,807 + 19,749): ratio 0.7675. 72,004 x 1,292 x 0.7675 x 1.5 = 107.1 million; rounded up, 110 million.
budget_basis.mimo: Design §5: the real OMPF tokens per attempt, scaled by the smoke ratio, times 1.5. MC-116's OMPF used 103,726,564 tokens in 1,296 attempts (80,036 each). On the same two smoke questions OMPS used 58,978 tokens (20,514 + 38,464) against OMPF's 91,066 in MC-116's smoke report a4bafda5 (37,850 + 53,216): ratio 0.6476. 80,036 x 1,292 x 0.6476 x 1.5 = 100.5 million; rounded up, 110 million.
